sections.title: VIP Majlis
sections.purpose: CEO visitors, VIPs and special guests.
experience: Distinct hospitality area around the existing curved seat.
Warm plaster, amber line and navy sign are a layered-interior proposal.
sections.note: No new seating was added; preserve the user's existing seat.

sections.title: Welcome & Hospitality
sections.purpose: Welcome, usher guidance and Arabic treats.
experience: Ushers orient visitors at the entrance.
Arabic treats are offered at the existing counter.
sections.note: The S1 welcome leads into the S2 introduction route.

sections.title: Manga Productions Introduction
sections.purpose: Introduce Manga Productions through the complete L-shaped route.
experience: Existing timeline on the outer wall.
Approved From sketch to screen: Imagine, Storyboard, In Colour.
Approved 15-position recognition gallery after the left turn: three bays, three shelf levels, 6 + 6 + 3.
sections.status: timeline retained; process wall and 15-trophy installation approved
sections.note: The portrait display is a 20-second silent artwork montage, not anime episode footage. Trophy forms are placeholders; final inventory, dimensions, weights and screen content remain pending.

sections.title: Central Activation
experience: WATCH / READ / PLAY selector with three angled touch surfaces is proposed.
Hardware is modeled; interactive software is not implemented.
sections.note: The activation format is not yet specified in the authoritative brief.

sections.title: Game IPs
experience: Proposed macro-forest scenic layers and three game demo positions.
Supplied IP posters are concept screen artwork, not newly created gameplay footage.
sections.status: purpose approved; interior and demo treatment proposed
sections.note: The proposed scenery is a generated background reconstruction; supplied source posters remain intact.

sections.title: Anime & Manga
experience: Proposed manga browsing and character photo moments.
DUB A SCENE screen and microphone are a proposed experience.
sections.status: purpose approved; interior and interaction treatment proposed
sections.note: Original display furniture is retained; the dubbing interaction is not implemented software.

variants.title: Base
variants.subtitle: Plain neutral walls with straight level tops
details: Four plain replacement walls retain the established curved footprint and interiors.
A neutral exterior option for design comparison, with no heritage treatment.

variants.title: Diriyah
variants.subtitle: Earthen heritage finish
details: Triangular motifs and earthen material interpretation.
Applies only to perimeter-facing Rear, Front Left and Entry walls.

variants.title: Rijal Almaa
variants.subtitle: A skyline of stepped stone houses
details: Several raised stone-house tops with lower links, varied heights, pale coping and darker charcoal interior walls.

variants.title: Jeddah Al-Balad
variants.subtitle: Varied house tops, cornices and timber screens
details: Different-height house tops with cornices and timber crowns, plus darker warm-gray interior walls.
A shallow scenic exterior study, not a literal historic reconstruction.
Saved render dated 13 October 2026; scene saved as AJ27-04-Jeddah-Al-Balad.blend.

decisions.text: The web uses the original saved booth export plus Base and Rijal/Jeddah wall supplements. The revised profiles were saved from inspected live Blender on 12 October. Base, Rijal and Jeddah renders are dated 12 October; Diriyah is dated 11 October.
The 12 × 9 m footprint, section layout and interior features are preserved; Rijal and Jeddah use independent structural walls and facade tops.
Do not present proposed activation formats, final awards inventory, final screen media, or trophy specifications as approved.
